subject: [PATCH 02/11] nfsd: take freeze protection before updating delegation timestamps

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch addresses a bug in the NFS server where it attempts to update inode timestamps while the filesystem is frozen, leading to inconsistent state and potential data corruption. The fix involves taking freeze protection before updating delegation timestamps in three functions: cb_getattr_update_times(), nfsd_update_cmtime_attr(), and nfsd4_finalize_deleg_timestamps(). In cases where the filesystem is frozen, the patch returns an error code instead of waiting for the thaw or attempting to update the timestamps. This ensures that the NFS server behaves correctly even when dealing with frozen file systems.
